snippet.title: New Adventure Island / opening intro and auto demo / Turbografx-16 1992
snippet.description: Automatic demo. New Adventure Island is a 1992 action platform game by Hudson Soft for the TurboGrafx 16. The game was released shortly after Super Adventure Island, making it the fourth game in the overall Adventure Island series.
